{{Quote|Four flaky daggert fillets are dipped in batter, fried golden brown in aola and served on a bed of crunchy sea cabbage with our own secret-recipe Iskalonian tartar sauce.|Dex's Diner menu, on its scalefish fillets|<ref name="Menu" />}}
'''Scalefish fillets''' was a [[Foodstuff/Legends|seafood dish]] served at [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]<ref name="Menu" /> located in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> Made from meat of [[Mee/Legends|daggerts]],<ref name="Menu" /> a type of [[Fish/Legends|fish]] [[Homeworld/Legends|native]]<ref name="Wildlife Field Guide">''[[The Wildlife of Star Wars: A Field Guide]]''</ref> to the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]<ref name="Atlas" /> planet [[Naboo]],<ref name="Wildlife Field Guide" /> the dish consisted of four flak fillets fried in [[aola]] until golden brown and served on a bed of crunchy [[sea cabbage]] along side the [[Restaurant/Legends|diner's]] special [[Iskalonian tartar sauce]]. Dex's Diner sold its scalefish fillets for 6.7 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] as part of its [[Foodstuff/Legends|lunch]] favorites<ref name="Menu" /> at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]].<ref name="DexDates">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}} is set at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]] per the {{DiningAtDexDate}}.</ref> 

==Behind the scenes==
Scalefish fillets were mentioned in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," an article written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner that was published on the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] section of [[StarWars.com]] on [[December 3]], [[2009]].<ref name="Menu" />
